reviews.title: On time , good service and cheap
reviews.text: The check in was efficient. Boarding the same but we had to take a bus to get to the airplane which turned out to be a 747-400. Amazingly large airplane when you boarding using stairs. Cabin crew were warm , welcoming and good looking. The flight took off right on time. I was seating in the very first row of lower cabin ! Feels strange knowing the cockpit is in top floor. A very nice hot breakfast was served , free of charge. The inflight entertainment was lacking as they only had a few public screens. Over all a great 4 hours flight.

reviews.title: On time, great service and cheap flight
reviews.text: I am a gold member of this airline so was able to check in at the business class counter which was fast and efficient. The lounge was quite, with style and well stocked. Boarding was fast although we had to take a bus to the airplane. Upon arriving to the airplane I saw to my astonishment that it was a 747-400 !!! I got the very front row seat on the lower cabin. Cabin crews were very nice and good looking. The airplane and was room were extremely clean. The huge airplane started and took off on time which looking at all those passengers it seemed impossible task to me ! Hot Breakfast was served after take off and by the way it was free of charge. As for inflight entertainment they just had a public screen. This was the only draw back on this 4 hour flight. Over all a very nice experience.

reviews.title: A really nice experience

The A310 used on this flight was old but you couldn't tell since the cabin, seats , toilet were all refurbished and felt new and clean. Very professional cabin crews and one hostess help me put my carry on bag overhead which was nice. For a one hour domestic flight they served a nice cold snack which can be considered light dinner to all passengers. For free ! The lady Captain made the flight smooth and landed so gentle at Kerman. Over all a exceptional experience.

reviews.title: Worth the Money
reviews.text: I was apprehensive flying to Iran, but as it needed to be done for work, I opted to fly Mahan Air business class as it was cheaper than Emirates economy class. (airplane was Airbus A340-600). My side of the plane was not so full, so I felt at ease. the leg room was great and tray table was huge (staff gave me a huge wipe to clean the tray table and set the cloth over it). The staff were extremely friendly and considering COVID and everything that goes with it, the food selection was good. My only issue was that we were sitting in the plane without the engine running, so the cabin got hot and stuffy since no air was flowing. Again, considering COVID and all that, THIS was not good. But, overall, for the money, flight, both ways, was pleasant an hassle free. (For those who have never flown this airline, heads up!, no inflight entertainment whatsoever)

reviews.title: International and domestic flight with Mahan Air
reviews.text: It was a organized circuit by a travel agency, so I ignore the final price of flights. In theory departure time of BCN was at 11.35 AM, in the same Airbus 340 that had to leave from Tehran at 6.40 AM (time difference 1h 30m), flight lasting 5h 25m. It arrived with some delay and ended up leaving back after 12.00 AM. This flight was quite little busy and although in row 23 I still had the wing covering part of the view, then later could go to the rear section, even both sides, and enjoyed the views when the clouds allowed. The cabin staff was correct and restrainedly friendly. They served us an abundant meal and then some extras; drinks without alcohol, of course. The itinerary and flight schedule were continuously detailed on the general screen. I did not measure the space between seats but did not suffer from stress in this regard. We landed in Teheran at 8.15 PM. The next day we flew from Teheran to Shiraz in a similar plane, quite busy this time, leaving at 8.00 PM. Despite being a domestic flight, lasting 1h 30m, we were served a full dinner, a nice detail. The return departure from Teheran to Barcelona was scheduled at 6.40 AM. The night before we stayed at the airport's Ibys hotel, from which we took the 3.40 shuttle (it passed every 20 min). This flight took off with little delay and was also quite busy, but yet several of us were able to move to a more forward seat to have a better view. The breakfast was generous.
